Conforming snapshots require fresh checks. Uncertain rights/privacy/provenance, new categories and unresolved drift escalate to human review.

source_resource_allowlist.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
source_resource_allowlist.public_manifest_rule: Generate a distinct public projection manifest enumerating only actually published allowed files. The private pilot manifest is evidence, not a ready-to-upload public manifest; private metadata files must not be advertised as publicly retrievable.

organisation_review_rule.basis: Verify each proposed organisation identifier/title against primary official institutional evidence and the approved non-personal category.
organisation_review_rule.straightforward_conformance: No second human approval is required for straightforward official non-personal pairs after standing-policy approval.
organisation_review_rule.human_escalation: Ambiguous identity, personal information, conflicting rights or a new content category remain quarantined for human review.
organisation_review_rule.changed_pair_rule: New or changed pairs trigger a fresh agent conformance check; only ambiguous cases require human escalation.
organisation_review_rule.attribution: Agent checks must identify the agent and evidence; never impersonate user review.

source_resource_allowlist.note: A numeric lexical value is not proof of non-sensitivity; aggregation and context require review.

takedown_procedure.intake: Use repository issue/contact channel only for non-sensitive locator/hash; sensitive complaint details remain private
takedown_procedure.immediate_action: Pause affected source publication; mark current entry quarantined and stop serving affected pointer
takedown_procedure.historical_action: Locate all affected payload hashes across HF historical revisions and mirrors; remove/disable access through reviewed provider-supported operations, or restrict the affected repository until remediation is verified
takedown_procedure.verification: Anonymous access checks for current and known historical object locations; do not claim removal while historical bytes remain public
takedown_procedure.audit: Minimal public tombstone with reason category and private incident evidence; preserve original only where permitted
takedown_procedure.resume: Attributable decision confirming resolution plus fresh source/privacy checks

proposed_standing_policy.mixed_correspondence_rule: Umbrella approval alone does not approve mixed correspondence; each source/content rights rule remains pending until independently evidenced.

delegated_admission.allowlist_role: output of successful admission and runtime enforcement; not separate human approval for every URL
delegated_admission.initial_organisation_review: Required before CA raw admission: agent evidence-based conformance review of the 162 proposed pairs; ambiguous cases remain quarantined for human review.
